title: Private Hawaii Pearl Harbor Tours and North Shore (up to 12 people )
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: USS Arizona Memorial tickets are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are excited to offer a day full of diverse activities that will give you a glimpse to the natural beauty of Oahu. You will start the day with a very historical and solemn site, will taste some local coffee, tour the pineapple garden, have a stroll at a bohemian town, look for some turtles, eat at a food truck park and will end the day with a swim in a waterfall that is very easy to get into.We can’t wait to have you on board and share this beautiful day with you!
